releases.name: 翻墙新闻（FQNews）安卓APP
releases.body:
添加任何墙外新闻的RSS/FEED，无需VPN，只需导入一个翻墙节点，FQNews APP会在后台自动翻墙下载新闻并缓存到本机，FQNews也内置了禁闻网的一些栏目。

本APP需要导入翻墙节点才能正常运行，请将节点拷贝到剪贴板后，然后点 导入节点 ，每行一个，数量不限，支持节点类型及格式如下:
ss://...
vmess://...
vless://...
trojan://...

用户请下载安装 fqnews2.apk.

文件 libcore.aar 仅限开发者使用，普通用户请忽略。

aiSummary.oneLiner: A comprehensive repository of circumvention tools, pre-configured clients, and deployment tutorials for bypassing internet censorship.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This project serves as a centralized, extensively documented archive for software and configurations designed to bypass network firewalls and strict internet censorship. It aggregates a wide variety of modern proxy protocols, including V2Ray, Shadowsocks, Trojan, and Brook, providing both client downloads and step-by-step server deployment tutorials. The repository uniquely maintains ready-to-use packages like Chrome, Edge, and Firefox portable builds pre-configured with proxy extensions. It actively lowers the barrier to entry for users seeking unrestricted internet access by providing free shared accounts and simplified guides for platforms ranging from Android and macOS to routers and game consoles.
keyFeatures: Pre-configured browsers: Offers heavily integrated portable versions of Chrome, Edge, and Firefox with built-in circumvention tools requiring zero setup.
Extensive protocol diversity: Supports and documents modern proxy protocols like V2Ray, Trojan, ShadowsocksR, and BifrostV.
Server deployment guides: Provides meticulous step-by-step documentation for users self-hosting V2Ray or Shadowsocks instances on personal VPS infrastructure.
Multi-platform clients: Aggregates client software and comprehensive tutorials spanning Android, macOS, Linux, Windows, routers, and even gaming consoles.
Free account distribution: Actively maintains lists of publicly available, free proxy credentials for users needing immediate network access.

useCases.title: Bypassing Strict Censorship

useCases.title: Console Network Routing
useCases.description: Gamers utilizing the router and macOS gateway tutorials to route PlayStation or Switch traffic through proxies to bypass regional gaming restrictions.
